raw: {"title":"平抛与斜抛运动纯物理模型","domain":"projectile","model_js":"globalThis.coursewareModel=Object.freeze({sample:function(input){var sc=(input&&input.scenario)||{};var ts=(input&&input.times_s)||[];function N(v,d){var n=Number(v);return isFinite(n)?n:d;}var g=N(sc.g_m_s2,10),m=N(sc.mass_kg,1),v0=N(sc.speed_m_s,0),x0=N(sc.x0_m,0),y0=N(sc.y0_m,0),deg=N(sc.angle_deg,0),mode=String(sc.mode||'oblique');var th=(mode==='horizontal'?0:deg)*Math.PI/180;var vx0=v0*Math.cos(th),vy0=v0*Math.sin(th);var disc=vy0*vy0+2*g*y0;if(disc<0)disc=0;var tf=g>0?(vy0+Math.sqrt(disc))/g:0;var range=x0+vx0*tf;var apexT=(g>0&&vy0>0)?vy0/g:0;var maxH=(g>0&&vy0>0)?y0+vy0*vy0/(2*g):y0;var opt=(g>0&&v0>0)?45:0;function st(t){t=N(t,0);if(t<0)t=0;if(g>0&&t>tf){return{t_s:t,x_m:range,y_m:0,vx_m_s:0,vy_m_s:0,ax_m_s2:0,ay_m_s2:0,kinetic_j:0,potential_j:0,mechanical_j:0};}var x=x0+vx0*t;var y=y0+vy0*t-0.5*g*t*t;var vy=vy0-g*t;if(g>0&&y<0)y=0;var ke=0.5*m*(vx0*vx0+vy*vy);var pe=m*g*y;return{t_s:t,x_m:x,y_m:y,vx_m_s:vx0,vy_m_s:vy,ax_m_s2:0,ay_m_s2:g>0?-g:0,kinetic_j:ke,potential_j:pe,mechanical_j:ke+pe};}var states=[];for(var i=0;i<ts.length;i++)states.push(st(ts[i]));return{states:states,events:{flight_time_s:tf,range_m:range,apex_time_s:apexT,max_height_m:maxH,optimal_equal_height_angle_deg:opt}};}});"}
